## Agenda

- Recap (5 min)
- 8.1  Writing the paper (II): Introduction, Discussion, Abstract, Title
- Manuscript workshop 2: complete the draft
- 8.2  Getting published: from checklist to proofs
- 8.3  Be the reviewer: appraise Papers 1 and 2
- Group presentations: proposal + publication plan

## Timetable

| Start | Clock* | Min | Segment |
|:----|:----|---:|:------------------------------------------------------------|
| 0:00 | 08:00 | 5 | Recap |
| 0:05 | 08:05 | 25 | **8.1 Writing the paper (II):** Introduction funnel, Discussion six moves, calibrated language, conclusion, abstract, title & keywords |
| 0:30 | 08:30 | 30 | **[DS] Manuscript workshop 2:** Introduction, Discussion, Abstract and Title → complete draft |
| 1:00 | 09:00 | 15 | BREAK |
| 1:15 | 09:15 | 25 | **8.2 Getting published:** reporting guidelines (**EQUATOR demo**), choosing a journal, open access & licences, predatory journals, submission package, peer review, responding to reviewers, rejection & resubmission, proofs, conference abstracts |
| 1:40 | 09:40 | 20 | **8.3 Be the reviewer:** simplified appraisal of Papers 1–2 (jigsaw, 10-question checklist) — training for the manuscript peer review after the course |
| 2:00 | 10:00 | 45 | **Group presentations:** own-topic research proposal + publication plan (5 groups × 6 min + 2 min feedback) + 5-min summary of the manuscript work |
| 2:45 | 10:45 | 15 | Post-course quiz, evaluation, next steps (peer-review swap of manuscripts as homework) |

\*Times are relative to the start of the session; the clock column shows an example 08:00–11:00 session. **[DS]** = course-dataset content (FLUID-ICU analysis and manuscript writing).

## Before this session

- Presentation ready (6 slides, 6 minutes).
- Your Methods + Results draft and your results pack.
- The abstracts of Papers 1 and 2 read.

## After this session (homework)

- Polish the manuscript and submit it (see the [manuscript brief](manuscript-brief.qmd)).
- Peer-review swap: review another group's draft with the 10-question checklist, then answer the review with the response-to-reviewers template — within **2 weeks** ([peer-review instructions](peer-review.qmd)).
- Writing exercises (Part A of the Session 8 sheet) for practice.
